meta.name: debugging-wizard
meta.description: Parses error messages, traces execution flow through stack traces, correlates log entries to identify failure points, and applies systematic hypothesis-driven methodology to isolate and resolve bugs. Use when investigating errors, analyzing stack traces, finding root causes of unexpected behavior, troubleshooting crashes, or performing log analysis, error investigation, or root cause analysis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 解析错误信息，追踪执行流，定位并修复代码缺陷
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要从堆栈跟踪和日志中找出代码问题的根源
copy.tagline_en: Parse error messages, trace execution flow, and fix bugs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to find root causes from stack traces and logs

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先尝试复现问题,再逐步缩小范围,一次只验证一个假设,最后给出修复方案并补充回归测试;过程中它会解析报错信息、追踪堆栈、比对日志来定位故障点。
howto.when: 当你说到“调试”“报错”等词,或要求排查问题、分析日志、追查崩溃时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析这个报错信息,找出根本原因
say.note: Claude 会解析报错并给出根因、证据、修复和预防方案。

say.text: 根据这段堆栈跟踪,定位是哪一行代码出问题
say.note: 它会顺着堆栈追踪执行流程。

say.text: 把这些日志关联起来,看看故障点在哪里
say.note: 它会比对日志条目来定位故障。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will first try to reproduce the issue, narrow it down step by step, test one hypothesis at a time, then provide a fix and add regression tests. It parses error messages, traces stack traces, and correlates logs to locate failure points.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention words such as "debug", "error", or ask to investigate an error, analyze a stack trace/log, or find a root cause.

say_en.text: Help me analyze this error message and find the root cause.
say_en.note: Claude parses error, gives cause, evidence, fix, prevention.

say_en.text: Given this stack trace, locate which line is failing.
say_en.note: It traces the execution flow through the stack.

say_en.text: Correlate these logs and point out where the failure occurs.
say_en.note: It matches log entries to identify the fault point.
